_comment: Unified site list for Deep Research. One entry per site: url + login_required (the green/red dot). login_required=false = searchable logged out (runs on hosted AND local); true = needs a login (local uses the encrypted vault silently; hosted, or local without a stored login, prompts for ONE-TIME credentials that are never saved); null = untested (the Sources-panel probe fills it in). The research plan still selects only the topically-relevant sites per query, on both instances. Optional 'note' aids that relevance selection and is not shown in the simplified UI. Edit locally + commit; edits made on the hosted site are ephemeral (Render disk).
